side.reading: not a skill signal: the side pick is graded against our own number, so coin-flip behaviour is expected. The p-value is shown to prove nothing was hidden, not to claim an edge.

error_statistics.unit: points per game; MAE is the number a bettor actually cares about because it is what has to beat the spread to make money
